displayTitle: The Secrets of the Jedi: The Chronicles of Luke Skywalker
synopsis: The Secrets of the Jedi: The Chronicles of Luke Skywalker is a reference book that is an updated version of the 2019 book Star Wars: The Secrets of the Jedi by Marc Sumerak. Take a journey through the light side of the Force to learn the history of the Jedi Order and its allies, as told from the perspective of one of the Order's most famous individuals, Luke Skywalker.This comprehensive guide to the Jedi contains a wealth of knowledge told from Luke Skywalker's perspective, to include introductions to other famous light-side characters such as Qui-Gon Jinn, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Ahsoka Tano, and more. Featuring captivating illustrations and a detailed history of the Jedi, this book provides important information about the mysterious Order and the Force.UPDATED EDITION: This completely redesigned edition of Star Wars: The Secrets of the Jedi includes all-new information conveyed through recent TV series, publishing, and films released since the first edition.
title: Star Wars: The Secrets of the Jedi: The Chronicles of Luke Skywalker
